claim: `normalized` is declared in the root namespace with a very generic name, one letter away from the existing root-level `normalize` of `NormalizationMonoid`, whose lemmas `normalize_zero` and `normalize_idem` are the same shape as this PR's `normalized_zero_eq_zero` and `normalized_normalized`. Users searching or autocompleting `normalize*` will get two unrelated families. The other Mathlib functions that rescale an object to unit size are namespaced and use the verb: `FiniteMeasure.normalize` and `PMF.normalize`.

claim: The new notion lacks the basic lemmas users need most. There is no reconstruction lemma `‖x‖ • normalized x = x`, which holds unconditionally because both sides are 0 when x = 0. There is no `normalized_eq_zero_iff`, and no bridge to the existing `‖x‖⁻¹ • x` API: sphere membership, the closed unit ball, `SameRay`. The analogous 1-dimensional notion `Real.sign` does ship `sign_eq_zero_iff`, `sign_of_pos`, `sign_of_neg` and `sign_neg`.
requested_change: Add at least `norm_smul_normalized (x : V) : ‖x‖ • normalized x = x` (proof via `smul_inv_smul₀ (norm_ne_zero_iff.2 hx)` after a zero split), `@[simp] normalized_eq_zero_iff : normalized x = 0 ↔ x = 0`, `normalized_mem_sphere (hx : x ≠ 0) : normalized x ∈ sphere 0 1`, and a `SameRay` characterization `SameRay ℝ x y ↔ x = 0 ∨ y = 0 ∨ normalized x = normalized y`, restating `sameRay_iff_inv_norm_smul_eq`.
